project.name: Axiom
project.summary: A deterministic embodied-evolution sandbox whose buffer-reused rollout path, measured on Arm64, cuts allocation/reallocation calls by 94.38% and requested allocation bytes by 89.73% while preserving the complete evolution report.
project.ai_usage: Axiom evolves morphology and feedforward, recurrent, and CPG neural controllers in terrain simulations, preserving diverse behaviors in a MAP-Elites archive.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped profile the rollout hot path, implement reusable neural/observation/snapshot workspaces, build the isolated Arm64 evidence harness, verify exact semantic equivalence, and strengthen tests, CI, architecture, and submission documentation.
